svg.text: Actual connector VBUS qualifies each independent full-speed data pair. There is no electrical U2-to-U4 data path.
J2 is a device connector. A USB-C version requires verified passive Rd and both plug orientations.
J2 VBUS goes only to IC2's protected B path and separate sense. Keep M1's native series resistors.
U4 downstream PIO full-speed host data
GP14 D+ and GP15 D-. Use one qualified 15k pulldown per J4 signal. Check stock weak pulls and FS
IC11 U2_RAW separate threshold and dwell
GP18 low reads the U2 data-switch command.
IC13 U4_VBUS separate threshold and dwell
GP20 low reads the U4 data-switch command. GP9 low always vetoes it.
U2 opens without valid J2 VBUS. U4 opens if VBUS falls invalid or GP9 drops. Both switches have power-off protection.
Electrical design review / Named nets are joined across sheets / x = intentional NC
MINIMUM CARRIER / DESIGN REVIEW / 2026-11-27 / Layout and qualification pending
